events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedy legend John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Icon
angles.copy: From Python to Fawlty Towers, John Cleese has given us decades of iconic comedy. Raising a glass to the man himself as he turns 87.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but widely known as the 'White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered the sprawling masterpiece that is the 'White Album'. Still sounds incredible, doesn't it?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's death anniversary
events.blurb: It's 35 years since the world lost legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we said goodbye to the one and only Freddie Mercury. His voice, his stage presence, truly irreplaceable.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Impact
angles.copy: An album that changed everything. The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' arrived this day in '65, pushing boundaries and setting new standards.

events.title: John Lennon's death anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, the world tragically lost music icon John Lennon.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, we lost John Lennon. His music and message continue to resonate globally.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Music legend David Bowie would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Tribute to Bowie
angles.copy: The Starman would have turned 80 today. Forever pushing boundaries, forever an icon. David Bowie, still missed.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: Long live the King. Elvis Presley would have been 92 today, and his music still gets the hips shaking.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar Legend
angles.copy: The architect of so many iconic riffs, Led Zeppelin's Jimmy Page turns 83 today. Still sounds as fresh as ever.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Iconic British singer Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Forever Young
angles.copy: From Faces to solo superstardom, the one and only Rod Stewart turns 82 today. Still got that unmistakable voice.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: One Step Beyond
angles.copy: One step beyond! The legendary Suggs from Madness turns 66 today. Still bringing the house down after all these years.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British pop and soul singer Paul Young celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Wherever I Lay My Hat
angles.copy: Wherever I lay my hat, that's my home... and today we're celebrating Paul Young's 71st birthday. What a voice.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Country music icon Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Working 9 to 5
angles.copy: Working 9 to 5 and still going strong! The incomparable Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday today.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: National Treasure
angles.copy: From boyband heartthrob to national treasure, Gary Barlow turns 56 today. Still got the magic touch.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Grammy-winning British singer Billy Ocean celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Get Into My Car
angles.copy: Get out of my dreams, get into my car... and celebrate Billy Ocean's 77th birthday! What a legend.

events.title: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction (1989)
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its fourth induction ceremony, honouring acts including The Rolling Stones and Stevie Wonder.

angles.name: Hall of Fame Legends
angles.copy: Back to '89, when the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame welcomed legends like The Rolling Stones and Stevie Wonder. A true who's who of music royalty.

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That singer Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Take That's Mark
angles.copy: The youngest member of Take That, Mark Owen, turns 55 today. Still got those boyband moves.

events.title: The Beatles' rooftop concert anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their iconic final live performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London.

angles.name: Rooftop Finale
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles played their legendary rooftop concert. What a way to go out.

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Legendary singer-songwriter and drummer Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: In The Air Tonight
angles.copy: Another year older, but still 'In The Air Tonight'. Phil Collins turns 76 today. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: Bringing Sexy Back
angles.copy: Bringing sexy back since the 00s! Justin Timberlake turns 46 today. What's your favourite JT banger?

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Sir David Jason celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: National Treasure
angles.copy: From Del Boy to Jack Frost, Sir David Jason is a true national treasure. Wishing him a very happy 87th birthday.

events.title: The Day The Music Died anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1959, rock and roll stars Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash, an event later immortalised as "The Day The Music Died".

angles.name: Music Lost
angles.copy: Sixty-eight years ago today, music lost three incredible talents in one tragic moment. Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: British pop singer Rick Astley celebrates his 61st birthday today.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give Up
angles.copy: Never gonna give up on celebrating Rick Astley's birthday! The 80s icon turns 61 today.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Reggae legend Bob Marley would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: One Love
angles.copy: One love, one heart, one birthday celebration for the legendary Bob Marley, who would have been 82 today.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Legendary singer-songwriter Carole King celebrates her 85th birthday today.

angles.name: Songwriting Genius
angles.copy: Tapestry and beyond – the incredible Carole King turns 85 today. A true songwriting genius.

events.title: Whitney Houston death anniversary
events.blurb: It's 15 years since the music world lost the incomparable voice of Whitney Houston, who passed away on this day in 2012.

angles.name: The Voice
angles.copy: Fifteen years since we said goodbye to 'The Voice'. Whitney Houston's legacy continues to inspire and move millions.
